verses.text: For the music director. To be played on stringed instruments, on the eight-stringed lyre. A psalm of David. LORD, do not correct me when you are angry. Do not punish me when you are furious.
Be kind to me, LORD, because I am weak. LORD, heal me, because my bones are shaking.
My whole being is in deep distress. LORD, how long will this go on?
Come back, LORD, and rescue me. Save me because of your faithful love.
The dead do not remember you. Who can thank you from the grave?
I am worn out from groaning. Every night my bed is flooded with my tears. I soak my couch with my crying.
My eyes grow weak with sorrow. They are worn out because of all my enemies.
Get away from me, all you who do evil, because the LORD has heard me crying.
The LORD has heard my cry for mercy. The LORD accepts my prayer.
All my enemies will be ashamed and terrified. They will turn back and suddenly be put to shame.
